item.title: C&K appoints Dr Fay Amaral as next CEO
item.description: Queensland not-for-profit early learning provider C&K has appointed Dr Fay Amaral as its next chief executive officer. Dr Amaral will start on 11 January 2027, the year C&K marks its 120th anniversary.

item.title: Australian educators invited to put early learning practices forward for US$100,000 award
item.description: Australian early childhood educators and providers have until 31 December 2026 to put forward programs or teaching practices that have improved early learning. Two US$100,000 prizes are on offer, with one awarded for practice and the other for published research.

item.description: The Australian Skills Quality Authority (ASQA) has set out what registered training organisations (RTOs) must do when ASQA cancels a qualification or statement of attainment.

item.title: Screen time study finds cognitive benefits alongside lower working memory accuracy
item.description: Higher amounts of screen time were associated with higher general cognitive abilities as adolescence. However, quicker responses to tasks measuring working memory were paired with lower accuracy.

item.title: What happens when children take the lead in neighbourhood play?
item.description: In Queensland neighbourhoods, children have been given a shared space close to home and the freedom to decide how to play there. Neighbourhood Backyards, a documentary produced by the Australian Institute of Play and Element Photo & Video Productions, follows what happened when communities made space for that kind of play.

item.title: YMCA Victoria backs ClinEd to bring clinicians into schools
item.description: YMCA Victoria will support funded places for at least three schools in communities facing disadvantage each year through a partnership with Guiding Growing Minds. The partnership runs until the end of 2029 and backs ClinEd, a year-long program that brings clinicians together with school staff to support children experiencing emotional and behavioural difficulties.

item.title: Pachamama Early Education and Care claims WA’s top KindiCare honour for the fourth consecutive edition
item.description: Pachamama Early Education and Childcare has won Western Australia’s top honour in the 2026 KindiCare Excellence Awards, with an Outstanding KindiCare Rating of 9.8 out of 10. It is the fourth consecutive awards edition in which one of Pachamama’s two Lesmurdie services has won the WA award.

item.title: New national supervision reforms to clarify educator ratios across services
item.description: Changes to supervision requirements in early childhood education and care will ensure greater clarity around when the across-the-services educator-to-child ratios can be used , such as in separate groups within a multi-level service, or on excursion vehicles.
